Validated all 12 new endpoints: profile completeness (8 checks, % math, increments on interests added), /options/profile-fields no-auth (12 goals + 20 questions), growth-goals (max 5 truncation, persistence), icebreakers (max 3 + empty-answer filter), pledge toggle on/off (pledge_signed_at set on enable), wellness checkin (invalid 400, 3-consecutive-down streak triggers show_support+support_message), wellness/status (wellness_prompt_at=20, daily_limit=30), take-break (paused_until +3d, demo2 excluded from demo1 discover) → resume (unset), transparency shape + badges + 0–110 score, /discover/todays-spark cached daily (2 calls = same pick.id + date + match_reasons), /discover/why returns 1–5 reason strings, chat/health green when 4 msgs <1h + red when forced to 60h, /chat/reignite returns exactly 3 topics (fallback if LLM fails — also works), /match/{id}/anniversary tier=week/month/legend at 7/30/90 days + null for 12 days. FREE_DAILY_SWIPES=30 confirmed via /discover swipes_remaining and db.users.daily_swipes_remaining.

minor.issue: Server applies `[:3]` BEFORE filtering empty answers, so submitting 5 answers where index 1 is empty results in only 2 saved (q1,q3) instead of 3 valid ones (q1,q3,q4). Fix: filter empties first, then truncate to 3. Spec said 'Empty-answer entries are filtered out' AND 'max 3 of 20' — current implementation silently drops valid answers if any earlier slot was empty.

today_checkin query uses `{'$gte': today_date_str}` where today is YYYY-MM-DD but created_at is full ISO datetime — relies on lexical sort. Works today, but if anyone seeds a record with non-ISO created_at this silently misses. Use `today_start_iso = datetime.combine(today, time.min, tzinfo=utc).isoformat()`.

match_reasons is only returned on the FIRST computation; subsequent (cached) calls return {pick, date} only — no match_reasons. Test request implied 'when first computed' is fine, but UI consumers may break expecting it always. Recompute or persist match_reasons alongside cached pick.

Hardcoded thresholds (<12h+>=4msgs=green, <48h=yellow, else red). No yellow path when count<4 but recent — newly-engaged matches with 1-3 msgs in the last hour are correctly bucketed as yellow ('slowing') because count<4 misses green, but the hint ('It's been a bit quiet') is misleading for an actively-started convo. Consider a 4th state 'starting' or relax green to count>=2 within 12h.
Endpoint returns the LLM-extracted JSON without VALIDATING it actually has exactly 3 topics. If LLM returns 2 or 5 it would pass through unchecked. Only the except path guarantees 3.

Milestone only fires on EXACT day 7/30/90 (`days == 7`). If a user opens the app on day 8 they miss it. Use `>=` with a 'shown' flag, OR widen to day-7..9 window. Currently a user who skips a day misses the milestone forever.
authenticity_score MAX is 30+20+20+10+20 = 100, not 110 as the test spec allows. Spec says 0-110; impl tops at 100. Either bump a tier by +10 or fix the spec.

Toggling pledge OFF does NOT clear pledge_signed_at — stale timestamp persists in DB even when anti_ghosting_pledge=false. Either `$unset` the timestamp on disable, or keep it but document that pledge_signed_at is 'last time signed' not 'currently signed'.

action_items: icebreakers endpoint: filter empties BEFORE [:3] truncation, otherwise valid answers are silently dropped.
anniversary endpoint: switch `days == 7` to `>=` with a once-shown flag so users who skip a day don't miss the milestone permanently.
todays-spark: include match_reasons on cached responses too (currently only on first compute).
transparency: spec says 0-110 but max is 100 — either add +10 tier or update spec.
/me/pledge: $unset pledge_signed_at when disabling, OR rename to last_signed_at.
reignite: validate LLM JSON has len(topics)==3, else fall back to default.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 2397 lines — even more overdue for a router split (mentioned in iter5 too).
/options/profile-fields hardcodes options inside server.py — move to a constants/config module so frontend i18n can reference the same source of truth.
/discover/todays-spark recomputes from scratch on cache miss and uses an in-memory scorer over up to 50 candidates — fine now but won't scale; consider precomputing nightly via cron.
Wellness `today_checkin` lexical date-string comparison against ISO datetime works only because both sides use UTC-ISO with the same format. Add a comment or convert to a proper datetime range.
_why_reasons uses set() which can reorder shared items each call — UI may show different order on each fetch; sort the lists.
/wellness/take-break clamps days to 1..7 silently — return 400 on out-of-range instead, otherwise client-side validation is the only contract.
compute_transparency runs N+1 mongo queries (one find_one per match for inbound/outbound). For a power user with many matches this is slow; use an aggregation pipeline.
